title: Sharp Makai-type inequalities for the best Poincaré-Sobolev constants
summary: Given a bounded convex open set $Ω\subseteq \mathbb R^N$, we prove that the Poincaré-Sobolev constants $λ_{p,q}(Ω)$ can be bounded from below by the $p$-power of the ratio between the perimeter of $Ω$ and a suitable power of its volume, with an optimal constant which is explicitly given. This generalises an old result for torsional rigidity due to Makai when $N=2$. The proof relies on new geometric optimal bounds for the Lebesgue norms of the distance function from the boundary which are of independent interest.
